title: Family Safety Capability and Policy Foundation
objective: Implement the bounded Family Safety Capability and Policy Foundation tranche after completed_verified MIB-16, without inferring implementation authority from selection.
selection_boundaries: MIB-16 is completed_verified and its implementation authority is retired.
No MIB-17 implementation branch, execution capsule, or implementation authority exists until a future owner Continue passes governed-start and production-readiness preflight.
next_action: On the next owner Continue, compile the MIB-17 execution capsule, verify application/AIOC family authority agreement and production worker readiness, run the transaction preflight, and only then create the single authorized implementation branch and enqueue one durable-supervisor job.
